name: pixellab_edit
description:
Edit / post-process existing PIXEL ART via Pixel Lab. Provide source image(s) via "image_inputs" (field → project path, auto base64); other fields go in "params". Results import to assets/pixellab/edits/. Some ops are async (return job_id).

REQUIRED FIELDS PER OPERATION (image_size is {"width":N,"height":N} of the SOURCE image unless noted):
- remove_background: image_inputs.image + params.image_size.
- image_to_pixelart: image_inputs.image + params.image_size + params.output_size {width,height} (the target pixel-art resolution).
- resize: top-level description + image_inputs.reference_image + params.reference_image_size + params.target_size {width,height}.
- inpaint / inpaint_pro: top-level description + params.image_size + image_inputs.inpainting_image + image_inputs.mask_image (white = area to regenerate).
- rotate: image_inputs.from_image + params.image_size + params.from_direction/to_direction (e.g. "south"→"east") or from_view/to_view.
- rotations_8_v2 / rotations_8_v3: image_inputs.from_image (+ image_size) to produce 8 directional rotations.
- edit_image / edit_images_pro: image_inputs.image(s) + top-level description of the change.

description.description: Edit instruction where the endpoint accepts one.

params.description: Other request fields (width/height for resize, from_direction/to_direction for rotate, image_size, etc.).

image_inputs.description: Map of API image field → project path. e.g. {"image":"assets/pixellab/images/hero.png"} or for inpaint {"image":"a.png","mask":"m.png"}.

wait_seconds.description: Block and poll up to N seconds for async ops (default 0).
